chunks: It is narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Bukayr, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “Among the blessings of a woman are the lightness of her expenses and the ease of her childbirth. And among her misfortunes are the heaviness of her expenses and the difficulty of her childbirth.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman, in the context of marriage and family life
key_terms.مَئُونَتِهَا: her expenses, upkeep, or financial burden

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say are signs of blessing and misfortune in a woman?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies certain practical qualities as signs of blessing or misfortune in family life. It presents ease in household burden and childbirth as forms of blessing, while hardship in these matters is described as a source of misfortune.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4359 - It is narrated from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, that

Abu Abdillah (as) said:
"Among the blessings of a woman are the lightness of her expenses and the ease of her childbirth. And among her misfortunes are the heaviness of her expenses and the difficulty of her childbirth."
